dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり１番はキムチですかね」
dialogues.en: "No doubt about it, kimchi is the best."
dialogues.text: "No doubt about it, kimchi is the best."

dialogues.jp:
こう、身体全体が燃え上がる感じが、冬にはた
まらないんだよな。
dialogues.en:
That spicy, burning feeling that runs throughout the entire
body is so good in winter.
dialogues.text:
That spicy, burning feeling that runs throughout the entire
body is so good in winter.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そうなんですか。じゃあ、今度作りますね」
dialogues.en: "I see. Then I will make it next time."
dialogues.text: "I see. Then I will make it next time."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ダメッ！」

ニッコリと微笑む、萌先輩の笑顔をかき消すよ
うにして、眞子が突然声を上げる。
dialogues.en:
Mako raises her voice suddenly, as if to wash out
Moe-sempai's smile.
dialogues.text:
Mako raises her voice suddenly, as if to wash out
Moe-sempai's smile.

dialogues.jp:
萌先輩がきょとんとした表情を向けると、眞子
が卵を片手に、顔を引きつらせていた。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai looks around in confusion. Mako's holding an egg
in her hand, but her face is twitching.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai looks around in confusion. Mako's holding an egg
in her hand, but her face is twitching.

dialogues.jp: 「どうしたんだ？　卵を握りつぶしたいのか？」
dialogues.en: "What's wrong with you? Do you want to crush the egg?"
dialogues.text: "What's wrong with you? Do you want to crush the egg?"

dialogues.jp: 慌てた表情の眞子の顔を、まじまじと見つめる。
dialogues.en: I look intently at Mako's panicked face.
dialogues.text: I look intently at Mako's panicked face.

dialogues.jp: ヒビの入りかけた卵を、器に置く。
dialogues.en: Mako puts the half-cracked egg on her serving dish.
dialogues.text: Mako puts the half-cracked egg on her serving dish.

dialogues.jp: 「なんで辛いのはダメなんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Why don't you want to eat hot food?"
dialogues.text: "Why don't you want to eat hot food?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「えっ……それは……あ、汗かいちゃうから」

なんだか、とってつけたような、歯切れの悪い
答えが返ってくる。
dialogues.en: She gave me an evasive reply.
dialogues.text: She gave me an evasive reply.

dialogues.jp: 「そんなん別にいいじゃんか」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「汗臭くなっちゃうでしょ」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「気にしなきゃいいだろ、そんなの」
dialogues.en: "You don't need to care about it."
dialogues.text: "You don't need to care about it."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「気にするのっ」

やけにムキになって拒絶する。汗なんて、体育
でマラソンするより、よっぽどかかないと思う
けど。
dialogues.en:
Getting too serious, she refuses to eat kimchi. I think
running a marathon in her gym class can make her sweat more
than eating kimchi.
dialogues.text:
Getting too serious, she refuses to eat kimchi. I think
running a marathon in her gym class can make her sweat more
than eating kimchi.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「とにかく、辛いのはダメなの」
結局、そこに行き着くのか。
dialogues.en: She comes to the conclusion in the end.
dialogues.text: She comes to the conclusion in the end.

dialogues.jp: 「だから、どうして？」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……あたしが、食べられないからっ」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「なによ」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「いや」

いくら辛いとはいっても、まさか、食べられな
いほど苦手とは思わなかった。
dialogues.en:
Kimchi's hot, but I didn't think that she hated it so much
that she couldn't even eat it.
dialogues.text:
Kimchi's hot, but I didn't think that she hated it so much
that she couldn't even eat it.

dialogues.jp:
正直、意外だ。こいつの燃える性格だったら、
ばりばりいけそうなイメージだったから。
dialogues.en:
Honestly, that surprised me. Because of her blazing
character, I thought she could easily eat up hot food.
dialogues.text:
Honestly, that surprised me. Because of her blazing
character, I thought she could easily eat up hot food.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「……私も知りませんでした……ごめんね、眞
　子ちゃん」
dialogues.en: "I didn't know about that either... I'm sorry, Mako."
dialogues.text: "I didn't know about that either... I'm sorry, Mako."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「別に、謝る必要はないでしょう」

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「とにかく、そう言う訳だから、キムチはパス」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, that's the reason, so I'm gonna pass on kimchi."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, that's the reason, so I'm gonna pass on kimchi."

dialogues.jp: 眞子がすっぱりと言い切る。

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉くん、ごめんなさいね」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「いえ。俺は別にかまいませんから」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: （しかし、眞子が辛いものが全くダメとは……）
dialogues.en: (But Mako can't take hot food at all......)
dialogues.text: (But Mako can't take hot food at all......)

dialogues.jp: ――意外だ。
◆キムチ鍋◆
俺はキムチ鍋が好きだ。
が、眞子は辛いのは駄目らしい。
dialogues.en: But Mako doesn't seem to like hot food.
dialogues.text: But Mako doesn't seem to like hot food.
